capital_policy: All free capital known at signal close funds next-session long entries equally among the top20. Existing qualifying holdings may receive additions; exit releases can fund the following signal’s orders. No shorts or collateral.
end_policy: Mark open positions at the final observed close; do not invent a terminal liquidation.
